about: What native OgreBot zone files (IC) and fight files (encounters) may contain: top-level keys, step shapes, actions with their ops and keys, conditions and {{ }} values. Types and defaults come from Ogre's zone-file docs; actions and conditions from the shipped files and the instance controller. Open IC Creator checks files with it.

types.bool|object: true, false or an object of its own keys
types.row: a row text or a 1-based row number
types.string|list: text, or a list of texts
types.object: an object of its own keys
types.spots|string: a list of [x, y, z], or the name of a spotTables list
types.value|index: a whole number, or text such as next, a {{...}} value or a computed value

zone.about: The zone name as the game shows it, without the difficulty tag.

variants.about: The difficulty tags the file covers, as the game writes them, such as [Heroic]; [] when the zone has none.

steps.about: The main list of steps. A run is enter, then steps, then exit.

enter.about: Steps run before steps. When enter fails, steps does not run.

exit.about: Steps run after steps; they run after a failure too, but not when the run is stopped, hits Max wait, or is given up after wipes.

entrance.about: { "loc": [x, y, z], "tolerance": 30 }: the zone-in spot (tolerance in meters, 30 when left out). Wipe recovery uses it to know the group is back at the zone-in. Nameds without an entrance load with a warning.

progression.about: sequential: a named that is up means every earlier named is taken as dead and skipped; use it only when each named appears after the one before dies. open: only the nameds IC saw die count.

rerunWholeZoneAfterWipe.about: true: after a wipe recovery, run the file again from the top (zones with teleporters inside).

wipeAttempts.about: How many wipe recoveries before the zone is given up: 0 to 10, 2 when left out.

onWipe.about: Your own wipe-recovery steps (recover ...) instead of the built-in recovery; [] gives the zone up at the first wipe.

afterWipe.about: Your own steps for a zone given up, instead of the built-in ones.

fileOptions.about: Up to 3 names for the IC window's File Option boxes, read as {{ic.options.fileOption1}} ... (TRUE or FALSE).

options.about: Your own values, read as {{ic.zone.options.<name>}}. IC itself does not use them.

difficulty.about: Adds a difficulty menu to the IC window: { "choices": [...] } or { "minValue", "maxValue" }. The run does not use it yet.

run.about: { "iss": "<path under Scripts>" } or { "json": "<zone file in the same folder root>" }: hand the zone to a script or another file. A script must call ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Complete when it is done. A file has run or steps, never both.

enabled.about: false hides the file from the IC list.

zoneFile.notes: A key starting with _ is a note: Ogre never reads it and never warns about it in a zone file.

stepId.about: The step's name, in the log and the IC window, and the name its result is kept under. Name each named named1, named2 ..., and its steps named1.walk, named1.chest: Skip the boss, the named # start and resuming go by these names.

onFail.about: fail ends the list when the step fails; proceed goes on. Left out: fail in a list, proceed inside a loop.

when.about: Conditions that must all hold, or the step is skipped (a skip is not a failure).

throttleMs.about: Skip the step if it ran less than this many milliseconds ago (handy in loops).

forwho.about: Which boxes run the step (a for-who). A zone file's steps run on the IC character, so here it only gates that box.

awaitWhen.about: Hold the step until these conditions hold (fight files use it, for example a roll call's window being over).

awaitTimeout.about: With awaitWhen: the longest to hold, in milliseconds.

wait.about: "ms" (a pause of limitMs), "atCampSpot" (until I stand on my camp spot), "moveFinished" (fight files: until my last move is done), or a condition to wait for.

limitMs.about: The longest wait, in milliseconds; for "ms" the pause itself.

onTimeout.about: What happens when the time runs out: proceed or fail. A "ms" wait must use proceed.

times.about: Run the steps this many times.

until.about: Conditions checked after each pass; the loop ends once they hold.

max.about: The most passes; needed with until.

find.about: One pass per actor found: { "query": "Name == \"...\" && Distance < 30" } (or name, tooltip, overlay ...).

spots.about: One pass per spot: a list of [x, y, z] (fight files: or a spotTables name).

vars.about: { "prefix": "...", "groupMember": true }: one pass per saved value whose name starts with prefix.

as.about: The name the current one is read under: {{seq.<as>.x}}, .y, .z, .loc, .id, .name, .distance.

path.about: Moves the group along the spots in order; at each spot it waits until everyone is there, alive and out of combat.

using.about: nav: each member walks itself on the nav mesh. campspot: the camp spot moves in straight lines and the group follows it.

spots.about: The spots, in order: [[x, y, z], ...].

groupWithin.about: Everyone must be this close to a spot (meters) before the walk goes on.

howClose.about: Read by the engine; not in Ogre's docs.

spotLimitMs.about: Time allowed per spot; fights, pauses and deaths do not count.

onSpotTimeout.about: A slow spot: retry (once more, then fail), fail, or proceed to the next spot.

waitForCombat.about: Hold at each spot while anything fights the group. false turns it off; an object gives waitForCombat keys.

waitForStragglers.about: With nav: wait for members who fall far behind.

exitOnActorAggro.about: A mob's name: the walk ends as soon as it fights the group.

fromStart.about: With campspot: always start at the first spot. Otherwise a group already near a later spot joins there.

sendTo.about: Who walks (a for-who); the whole group when left out.

killWithin.about: Stop to kill trash that comes this close (meters, at most 100), then walk on.

killTypes.about: With killWithin, what counts: NPC, NamedNPC, Special. Nameds are walked past unless NamedNPC is listed.

killLimitMs.about: With killWithin: the longest one stop may take before the mob is left behind (named in the console, not a failure).

legM.about: Read by the engine; not in the docs.

resWithin.about: Read by the engine; not in the docs.

resLimitMs.about: Read by the engine; not in the docs.

returnNoProgressMs.about: Read by the engine; not in the docs.

returnProgressDist.about: Read by the engine; not in the docs.

returnLimitMs.about: Read by the engine; not in the docs.

named.about: Kills one named: buffs up, walks to the kill spot, pulls, fights, waits for the death, then holds until the fight is over. Records killed, alreadyDead, skipped, neverSpawned or timedOut.

name.about: The named's exact name, as the game shows it.

spot.about: Where to fight it: [x, y, z].

navTo.about: Walk the group to the named wherever it stands (for one that roams).

aliases.about: Other names it shows or dies under.

boss.about: true for the zone's last boss: Skip the boss and the boss chest options act on it.

spawnWaitMs.about: How long to wait for it to spawn. One that never spawns does not fail the zone.

pullLimitMs.about: It must be fighting the group this soon after the pull.

limitMs.about: The longest the whole fight may take.

scanRadius.about: How far to look for it when pulling (meters).

scanHeight.about: How far up or down to look for it when pulling.

prebuffMs.about: How long the group buffs up before the pull; 0 skips the buff-up.

preCastTagMs.about: Read by the engine; not in Ogre's docs (a pre-cast window before the pull). Its default is not documented.

waitForCombat.about: Hold after the kill until nothing fights the group, as path does.

loot.about: Loots the chest, the shinies or the corpses near the group: moves there if needed, waits for the looting, then walks back. Never fails the zone.

valuesAbout.chest: the chest, found by its kind (Chest), not its name; waits up to 8 s for one after a kill, then loots the corpses too unless corpses is false
valuesAbout.corpses: unlooted corpses, nearest first, from where the step starts; usable after a trash pull too

within.about: How far to look (meters, at most 100); corpses default to 50.

boss.about: true on the boss chest: the Skip no-trade boss chest option acts on it.

back.about: Walk back to where the step started.

noTrade.about: loot or skip no-trade items, for this step only; the IC window's option when left out.

windowBaseMs.about: Read by the engine; not in Ogre's docs.

windowPerItemMs.about: Read by the engine; not in Ogre's docs.

corpses.about: Chest only: loot the corpses after the chest; false leaves them.

corpsesWithin.about: Chest only: how far from the start to look for corpses (meters, at most 100).

zoneOut.about: Leaves the zone with the group. Every zone file needs one, in enter, steps or exit. A failed zone-out does not fail the zone.

valuesAbout.door: click the exit named in name (it must match exactly)
valuesAbout.auto: the nearest clickable exit named zone exit, exit, zone_exit or exit_spawned; fails when there is none
valuesAbout.endOfZone: like auto, but only within searchWithin; finding none is not a failure, so add a fallback after it
valuesAbout.none: stay in the zone on purpose (the end-of-zone options still run)

destination.about: When the zone list pops up, the row to pick: its text, or its number (1 = the first). The last row when left out.

within.about: How close the group must be to click (meters).

walk.about: Walk the group to the exit when it is farther than within. Left out: false for door, true for auto and endOfZone.

searchWithin.about: endOfZone: how far to look for the exit (meters).

findLimitMs.about: How long to look for the exit.

zoneLimitMs.about: Zoning must start this soon after the click; IC clicks once more, then gives up.

groupLimitMs.about: How long to wait for everyone to arrive in the new zone.

teleporter.about: Takes the group through an in-zone teleporter: everyone clicks it, then IC waits until all are through and still. A member left behind is brought back. Fails when the teleporter is not there.

name.about: The teleporter's exact name, as the game spells it. Needed unless walkOnto is used.

walkOnto.about: A portal you walk onto, instead of a name: [x, y, z]. Needs landing.

landing.about: Where the group lands: lets a part-way run start on the far side.

limitMs.about: Time allowed for everyone to get through.

waitForCombat.about: Holds while anything fights the group (a gap between other steps; path and named already hold at every spot).

settleMs.about: When a mob is close, the time it gets to join the fight.

noProgressMs.about: A fight with no change for this long is stuck.

onNoProgress.about: moveOn leaves a stuck fight; fail fails the step. A named is never left.

limitMs.about: The longest the step may hold; reaching it while still fighting fails.

waitForLoot.about: Waits until OgreBot has looted everything in reach.

limitMs.about: The longest it waits with nothing new looted (it keeps waiting while corpses are opened); 0 = no limit.

onTimeout.about: At the limit: proceed (with a warning) or fail.

hunt.about: Kills every mob whose name contains name until the until mob shows up, then goes to it. AutoTarget is on (35 m) while it hunts. Running out of time does not fail the zone.

name.about: A part of the name of the mobs to kill.

until.about: The exact name that ends the hunt; the group goes to it, then the step ends.

untilLine.about: A chat line that also ends the hunt (a part of it is enough).

spots.about: Where to search from, in turn, when nothing is in sight.

limitMs.about: The longest the hunt may take.

trash.about: Clears every mob in a circle around where the step starts, one at a time (it pulls what stands inside the circle); it can also hold for waves.

types.about: What to kill: NPC, NamedNPC, Special.

until.about: An exact name: the step ends when it shows up.

whenEmpty.about: done: end when the circle is clear. wait: wait for the next wave.

quietMs.about: With wait: end after this long with nothing in the circle or fighting the group.

move.about: nav or campspot: walk to mobs more than 20 m away (the group comes back at the end); none stays put.

limitMs.about: The longest it may take; reaching it fails the step.

reward.about: Takes a reward from the reward window (the same choice every time).

choose.about: The reward's number (1 = the first) or its name.

limitMs.about: Time to wait for the window.

sendTo.about: Who takes the reward (a for-who); the whole group when left out.

groupQuery.about: Asks the group a question and keeps the answers as values: {{encounter.<var>.anyYes}}, allYes, yesCount, yesWho, noWho, missingWho and the like. Zone files only.

var.about: The name the answers are kept under.

question.about: itemCount (with item), abilityReady (with ability), slotResolve (with slot), or LavishScript["${...}"], which each member works out itself.

compare.about: With value: turns each answer into yes or no.

value.about: With compare: what each answer is compared with.

sendTo.about: Who is asked (a for-who); the whole group when left out.

limitMs.about: Time to wait for the answers.

askAgainIfBlank.about: Read by the engine; not in Ogre's docs.

progress.about: Marks a step done or skipped, so a later start or resume leaves it out.

recover.about: A wipe-recovery step, for the onWipe and afterWipe lists.

valuesAbout.revive: revive at the revive window row in at (else the last row listed)

limitMs.about: The time each operation may take.

at.about: revive only: the revive window row, such as Entrance.

zoneFile.alsoAllowed: Any fight-file action may also be a zone-file step (see fightFile.actions). It runs on the IC character only; it reaches the rest of the group only through sendTo, on the actions that take it (campSpot, ogreBotUIOption, actorInteract doubleClick, castAbility, movement, assist).

stepShapesAbout.do: An action: "do" names it and the step carries its keys.
stepShapesAbout.wait: A wait: "ms", "atCampSpot", "moveFinished" (fight files) or a condition, with limitMs and onTimeout.
stepShapesAbout.repeat: A loop: { "times": n } or { "until": [...], "max": n }, with its own steps.
stepShapesAbout.forEach: A loop over actors (find), spots or saved values (vars), with its own steps.
stepShapesAbout.use: Fight files: run a routine of this file, { "use": "<name>", "with": { ... } }.

named.about: [{ "name", "distance", "aliases" }]: the mobs this file is for. A setup starts when one of them is in a fight within distance (meters).

zone.about: The zone as the game shows it, with its difficulty tag; a list covers several zones; no zone means any zone.

expansion.about: A note for people (and the first folder of a shipped file's path).

setup.about: Steps every box runs when the setup starts: at the engage, or when asked (-SetUpFor).

triggers.about: Rules that fire when something happens (a line, a spawn, a detriment, a custom event): { "on", "match", "when", "forwho", "do" }.

onPulse.about: Rules checked on every pulse while the fight runs: { "id", "when", "do" }. Without everyPulse a rule fires once each time its when becomes true; with everyPulse it fires on every pulse while true.

initialize.about: { "events": [custom event names], "vars": { "<name>": "<value>" } }: the file's own events and starting values.

onKilled.about: { "<mob name>": [steps] }: steps run when that mob dies; leaving the zone runs them too.

spotTables.about: { "<table>": [[x, y, z], ...] }: named lists of spots, read by name (campSpot spotAt, bestOf, nearSpot, spotIndex ...).

routines.about: { "<name>": { "params": [...], "steps": [...] } }: steps run with { "use": "<name>", "with": { ... } }; {{<param>}} reads a parameter.

teardown.about: Steps run when the setup ends.

dets.about: { "<key>": { "main": <icon>, "back": <backdrop> } }: named detriments, read as { "det": "<key>" } in hasDet, detAdded and the like.

noMerge.about: A custom file at the shipped file's path replaces it whole instead of being laid over it.

enabled.about: false turns the file off without deleting it.

fightFile.notes: On a fight-file action only _comment and _why are silent notes; any other _ key is reported as not a field of that action. Every box that loads the file runs it: forwho picks which boxes run a step or a rule, sendTo picks the boxes a step sends its command to.

distance.about: How close (meters) the mob must be, in a fight, for the setup to start. Shipped files mostly use 100.

on.about: What sets the rule off: text, announcement, chat, spawn, spawnDelayed, despawn, detAdded, detRemoved, detUpdated, castEnded, or a custom event name.

match.about: Narrows on: { "mode", "needle" } for a line, { "name", "mode" } for an actor, { "main", "back" } or { "det" } for a detriment, { "abilityId" } for a cast.

when.about: Conditions that must all hold when it fires, or the rule does nothing.

forwho.about: Which boxes act on it (a for-who); every box when left out.

allowConcurrentRuns.about: false: a new firing while this rule's steps still run is dropped. true: each firing runs.

throttleMs.about: Ignore further firings for this many milliseconds (one call for several hits).

id.about: A name for the rule (logs; several rules on one event).

mode.about: Seen once, beside match; it belongs inside match.

fightFile.customTriggers: Any other "on" is a custom event: a timer or a broadcast, declared in initialize.events.

mode.about: substring (a part of it), exact, or regex.

name.about: spawn, spawnDelayed, despawn: the actor's name.

chatType.about: chat: the game's channel number (shipped files use 8, 10, 15, 16 and 28).

field.about: detUpdated: which value of the detriment, such as currentincrements.

back.about: The detriment's backdrop number (-1 where the backdrop does not matter).

det.about: A dets key instead of main and back.

compare.about: detUpdated: how field compares with value.

value.about: detUpdated: the value to compare with.

id.about: A name for the rule (logs; the ruleState condition reads it).

when.about: Conditions; the rule fires when they hold.

everyPulse.about: true: fire on every pulse while when holds. Left out: fire once each time when becomes true.

throttleMs.about: With everyPulse: at most once per this many milliseconds.

forwho.about: Which boxes check the rule (a for-who).

activeWhile.about: Lifecycle form: the rule is active while these hold.

onEnter.about: Lifecycle form: steps when it becomes active.

onExit.about: Lifecycle form: steps when it stops being active.

abortWhen.about: Lifecycle form: conditions that end it early.

runOnExitAfterwards.about: Lifecycle form: run onExit after an abort too (one shipped file; inferred).

runOncePerEncounter.about: Fire at most once per fight (one shipped file; inferred).

abilities.about: Turns a group of abilities on or off for these boxes (stuns, interrupts, dispels, AE abilities, bow abilities), or does one ability job (cast Bulwark of Order, stop casting, drop invisibility, set up for or reset Intercept).

allowCounters.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

allowEncounters.about: With aoes off: encounter AEs are still allowed (inferred).

sendTo.about: Also send it to these boxes (a for-who).

value.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

verbose.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

valuesAbout.setUpForIntercept: Intercept and Guardian off in the cast stack; guardians cancel Guardian

op.about: What to do: stuns, interrupts, dispels, dispelSetup, aoes, castBulwark, setUpForIntercept, resetForIntercept, cancelInvis, cancelCasting, bowAbilities.

abilityTracker.about: op add: starts tracking an ability for the group (OgreBot's ability tracker), for values such as groupCooldownSpread (inferred).

actorInteract.about: Does something to an actor found by name or id: double-click it, use a verb on it, target it, hail it, pick a dialog reply, or drop the target. A missing actor fails the step, so most such steps carry onFail proceed.

awaitCastBar.about: Wait for the cast bar the click starts.

choiceText.about: op dialog: the reply to pick (its text).

choices.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

id.about: The actor by id, such as {{seq.lever.id}} or {{actor.id}}.

maxRounds.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

sendTo.about: Others who do the same (doubleClick); in a zone file the step otherwise runs on the IC character only.

target.about: Who it is aimed at when that is not the actor itself (inferred).

untilDone.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

verb.about: op verb: the right-click verb, as the game words it.

valuesAbout.doubleClick: double-click it (doors, levers, items on the ground)
valuesAbout.verb: use the right-click verb in verb
valuesAbout.dialog: pick the reply whose text is choiceText

op.about: What to do: doubleClick, verb, target, hail, dialog, clearTarget.

announce.about: Writes a line to my console; console true writes it to every box's console, irc true also sends it over IRC, noise true plays a sound.

console.about: true: every box's console, not only mine.

irc.about: true: also send it over IRC.

message.about: The line; {{...}} values are filled in.

noise.about: true: play a sound with it.

assist.about: op anchor: the boxes in sendTo assist who (a name, {{me}}, or a preferredMember pick).

sendTo.about: Who assists, such as igw:{{me}} (my group) or irw:{{me}} (my raid).

valuesAbout.anchor: make the boxes in sendTo assist who

autotarget.about: Edits OgreBot's AutoTarget, the list of mobs to kill in order: add or remove mobs, clear it, set how far it looks, turn it or out-of-combat scanning on or off, hold it under a reason, load a saved list or preset. When a fight ends, the engine clears what that fight file added.

aggroOnGroupOnly.about: Only while it fights my group.

aggroOnNonFighterOnly.about: Only while it fights a non-fighter.

aggroOnNotMe.about: Only while it is not on me.

checkCollision.about: Only with a clear line to it (inferred).

enabled.about: op set: AutoTarget on or off.

height.about: op set or setScanHeight: how far up and down to look (meters).

hp.about: addActor: the health floor: it is taken while above this %; 0 = until it dies.

id.about: An actor id instead of a name.

maxHp.about: addActor: the health ceiling: only while at or below this %.

name.about: addActor, removeActor: the mob; a part of the name matches (NPC and NamedNPC work as type words).

outOfCombatScanning.about: op set: look for mobs out of combat too.

preset.about: loadPreset: the preset, such as Named.

radius.about: op set or setScanRadius: how far to look (meters).

reason.about: suppress, release: the hold's name; release must use the same one.

seconds.about: setRescanTime: how often to look again.

value.about: setEnabled, setOutOfCombatScanning, setWhenHated: true or false.

whenHated.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

valuesAbout.addActor: put name on the list (tried in the order added)
valuesAbout.deleteSaved: delete a saved list (no shipped use)

op.about: What to do: addActor, removeActor, clear, set, setScanRadius, setScanHeight, setRescanTime, setEnabled, setWhenHated, setOutOfCombatScanning, suppress, release, loadPreset, loadSaved, save, deleteSaved.

beltAdorn.about: Swaps the belt's immunity rune (adornment) to a kind: stun, stifle, mez, fear or medic. OgreBot takes a rune of that kind from the bags and puts the old one back in them; a box swaps only out of combat and standing still. A rune's kind is the end of its name, in every family (Corathus, Coldforged, Formless, Zimaran, Renewal ...): data/belt-runes.json lists them.

type.about: The kind of immunity: the rune whose name ends in Adamant Defiance (stun), Adamant Resolve (stifle), Astral Dominion (mez), Blinding Gleam (fear) or Field Medic (medic).

valuesAbout.stun: a rune whose name ends in Adamant Defiance
valuesAbout.stifle: a rune whose name ends in Adamant Resolve
valuesAbout.mez: a rune whose name ends in Astral Dominion
valuesAbout.fear: a rune whose name ends in Blinding Gleam
valuesAbout.medic: a rune whose name ends in Field Medic

unequip.about: true (Ogre's default) takes the belt off, puts the rune in and puts the belt back on; false puts the rune in the worn belt (OgreBotAPI.Inventory:ChangeBeltAdorn).

botPause.about: Pauses (value true) or resumes (value false) the bot on this box only.

broadcast.about: Sends a custom event to the boxes in sendTo; each runs its rules with on: <event>, with args in {{event.arg1}} ... A shipped note (2026-11-01) says it travels over OgreConsole, which stays on one PC.

event.about: The event name; list it in initialize.events.

includeSelf.about: false: not to me, even when sendTo names me.

sendTo.about: Who gets it: all, igw:{{me}}, irw:{{me}}, a class ...

camera.about: Sets the camera pitch or resets the camera. The engine knows it; no shipped file uses it.

firstPerson.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

campSpot.about: Changes OgreBot camp spots: the spot each box holds and walks back to. The base spot comes from setLoc and the like; a relative spot (setRelativeLoc ...) is a temporary spot that clearRelative drops, back to the current base. A box with no camp spot ignores moves, so enable (or setHere) comes first.

2d.about: Measure on the ground plane only.

angle.about: atAngleFromActor: degrees (0 = behind it, 180 = in front), behind, front, or a list [a, b] to pick from.

avoid.about: clearOf: { "find": {...}, "within": m }: what to keep away from.

by.about: setLocBy, setRelativeBy: the offset [dx, dy, dz].

circleSpots.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

dist.about: How far from the actor (meters); a computed value works.

find.about: bestOf: the actors to pick among.

from.about: bestOf: measure from me or from an actor.

fromOffset.about: Read by the engine (one shipped file).

howClose.about: How close counts as on the spot (meters, 2 by default).

howFar.about: The farthest a new spot may be from the box; a move beyond it is ignored (meters, 200 by default).

id.about: The actor, by id or name.

includeNpcSize.about: Count the actor's own size in dist.

index.about: spotAt: the spot number (1 = the first), next, or a {{...}} value.

indexVar.about: Keep the spot number in this encounter variable.

keepSpot.about: enable: keep the spot it had.

kind.about: formation: monkey (one box in the middle, the rest round it).

middle.about: formation: who stands in the middle.

minDistance.about: bestOf: leave out spots closer than this.

minMove.about: Read by the engine (one shipped file; inferred: ignore a smaller move).

nav.about: Walk on the nav mesh rather than straight (one shipped file; inferred).

nth.about: With name: the nth match, ids in order.

query.about: An actor query instead of a name, such as Tooltip=="...".

relative.about: true: set the relative spot instead of the base.

remember.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

sendTo.about: Also send it to these boxes (not with op clear: use clearAll).

skipIfAggro.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

spots.about: A list of [x, y, z], or a spotTables name.

step.about: clearOf: how far each step goes.

toward.about: towardLoc, clearOf: the spot to measure toward.

towardActor.about: towardLoc: an actor to measure toward.

valuesAbout.setLoc: base spot at loc (or x, y, z)
valuesAbout.setLocBy: move the base spot by [dx, dy, dz]
valuesAbout.enable: camp spot on where the box stands
valuesAbout.activate: use a saved camp spot slot (slot)
valuesAbout.clearRelative: drop the relative spot: back to the current base spot
valuesAbout.setCsp: read by the engine; no shipped use
valuesAbout.restoreCsp: read by the engine; no shipped use
valuesAbout.release: let go of the camp spot: the box follows again (inferred)
valuesAbout.clearAll: clear the base and the relative spot (the form sendTo can carry)
valuesAbout.setHowClose: how close counts as on the spot (value)
valuesAbout.setHowFar: the farthest a new spot may be (value)
valuesAbout.setUse3D: read by the engine; no shipped use
valuesAbout.setRelativeBy: relative spot at the base plus by
valuesAbout.setLocToActor: base spot on an actor (name or id, nth)
valuesAbout.atAngleFromActor: a spot dist m from an actor at angle (0 behind, 180 in front)
valuesAbout.trackLocToActor: read by the engine; no shipped use
valuesAbout.trackRelativeLocToActor: read by the engine; no shipped use
valuesAbout.clearTracking: read by the engine; no shipped use
valuesAbout.setHere: camp spot on where the box stands, with howClose and howFar
valuesAbout.bestOf: the nearest, farthest or nextAfterNearest of spots (pick), measured from me or from the actor in from
valuesAbout.spotAt: spot number index of spots; next steps round the list
valuesAbout.formation: kind monkey: a ring round a spot, dist apart, with middle in the middle
valuesAbout.towardLoc: a spot dist m from actor id, toward the place in toward or the actor in towardActor (a negative dist goes past it)
valuesAbout.clearOf: step away from avoid, step m at a time, up to maxDistance

op.about: What to do: setLoc, setLocBy, enable, disable, activate, clear, clearRelative, setCsp, restoreCsp, release, clearAll, setHowClose, setHowFar, setUse3D, setRelativeLoc, setRelativeBy, setLocToActor, setRelativeLocToActor, atAngleFromActor, trackLocToActor, trackRelativeLocToActor, clearTracking, setHere, bestOf, spotAt, formation, towardLoc, clearOf.

cancelMaintained.about: Cancels maintained spells by name on these boxes.

args.about: The spell names, such as ["Subtle Strikes"].

castAbility.about: Casts an ability on these boxes: by name or id; firstReady casts the first ready one of a list, allReady every ready one, abilityQuery picks by a property. It goes on OgreBot's cast queue with a high priority.

abilityId.about: The ability's id instead of its name.

abilityQuery.about: Pick by a property, such as ["IsStun", "=", "TRUE"].

allReady.about: Cast every ability in the list that is ready.

announce.about: { "message", "irc" }: say so when it casts; {{ability}} is the ability.

cancelCasting.about: Stop what is being cast first.

firstReady.about: Cast the first ability in the list that is ready.

name.about: Read by the engine: another way to give the ability.

priority.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

sendTo.about: Others who cast it too (a for-who).

target.about: Who to cast it on: a name, {{me}}, @target ...

castInterrupt.about: Each box fires its own fastest ready interrupt at the casting mob (Ogre's migration notes); usually gated on the namedCasting condition.

mob.about: The mob; the named when left out.

priority.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

castStack.about: Turns a cast-stack entry on or off (op set, value true or false), matched by the entry's ability name (match entry) or by a tag such as IsInterrupt (match tag). The fight's end does not put it back: set it back in onKilled.

ability.about: The entry (ability name) or the tag.

match.about: entry (an ability name) or tag (a keyword such as IsInterrupt).

valuesAbout.set: turn the entry on or off

choiceWindow.about: Answers a choice pop-up: accept presses OK, enterText types text into it.

clear.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

cures.about: Curing: auto-cures on or off, cure now, ask others to cure me (request) or the group (requestGroup), cast a group cure, click off a detriment, or drop pending requests.

priority.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

responders.about: Who should cure (a for-who); left out: my group.

target.about: Who needs the cure; me when left out.

valuesAbout.disable: auto-cures off (the fight's end does not undo it: enable again in onKilled)
valuesAbout.request: ask responders to cure target of kinds
valuesAbout.requestGroup: ask responders for a group cure
valuesAbout.cancelDetrimental: click off the detriment main / back on myself

op.about: What to do: enable, disable, now, request, requestGroup, castGroup, cancelDetrimental, clearRequests.

curses.about: Curse cures: request asks responders to cure the curse on target; order takes turns, by the index in var.

var.about: order: the encounter variable that holds the turn.

dispel.about: Dispels a detriment (main / back) off a mob: with whatever this box has ready (any), an ability, a spell, or an item.

mob.about: The mob (name or id); for op item, the named when left out.

priority.about: Read by the engine (one shipped file).

sendTo.about: Also send it to these boxes.

valuesAbout.any: any dispel this box has ready
valuesAbout.item: a dispel item (such as an Energy Inverter)

op.about: What to do: any, ability, spell, item.

examine.about: Reads a detriment's examine text (op det) into an encounter variable, so textContains can test it.

index.about: Which one of the table (1 = the first).

var.about: The encounter variable that gets the text.

fireEvent.about: Fires a custom event here, on this box (rules with on: <event> run); broadcast is the form that reaches other boxes (inferred).

flagToon.about: Numbered flags on boxes: set one (flag, value), clear them all, or pass flag n to the next person; the toonFlagged condition and the ToonFlagged:<n> for-who read them.

flag.about: The flag number (or a computed value).

value.about: true sets it, false clears it.

valuesAbout.nextPerson: pass the flag to the next person

op.about: What to do: set, clearAll, nextPerson.

gameCommand.about: Runs a game slash-command on these boxes: command plus args (such as pet attack, stand, autoattack).

heroicOpportunity.about: Heroic opportunity (HO) control: who may start, add to (starter) or finish (wheel) HOs, start one, do one alone on a target, advance it, cancel the starter, or forbid icons.

leaveWheelOpen.about: solo: leave the wheel open for others.

numToComplete.about: Read by the engine (one shipped file).

primeOnly.about: Read by the engine (one shipped file).

reason.about: cancelStarter: a name for the log.

skipTimer.about: Read by the engine (one shipped file).

starter.about: op set: may add to the starter.

surge.about: op set: Heroic Surge on or off.

target.about: The mob to do it on.

timeout.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

wheel.about: op set: may finish the wheel.

valuesAbout.noAutoStart: read by the engine; no shipped use
valuesAbout.set: start / starter / wheel / surge on or off
valuesAbout.solo: do the HO alone on target
valuesAbout.allowIcon: allow an icon again (no shipped use)

op.about: What to do: noAutoStart, set, start, solo, startSolo, stopSolo, cancelStarter, advance, disableIcon, allowIcon, clearIcons.

inventory.about: op destroy: destroys count of an item (by name or iconId) from the bags.

iconId.about: The item's icon id, instead of its name.

joust.about: Joust: out sends these boxes out of the mob's reach (their joust spot); in brings them back. Shipped setups run out for all first; their notes say that clears a joust hold left from before and moves nobody.

valuesAbout.on: read by the engine; no shipped use
valuesAbout.off: read by the engine; no shipped use

op.about: What to do: out, in, on, off.

loot.about: Fight files: op assign gives an item in an open Leader Only loot window to a member (to). In a zone file, loot is the zone step instead.

to.about: Who gets it (a name, often a saved value).

valuesAbout.assign: give the item to a member

merchant.about: op buy: buys count of item from the merchant actor, which must be in reach. The engine knows it; no shipped file uses it.

actor.about: The merchant (needed: there is no automatic pick).

onlyBuyWhenUnder.about: Buy only while the bags hold fewer (inferred).

method.about: Calls an OgreBotAPI method by name with args: an escape hatch the shipped files moved away from. For most methods the first argument is the for-who.

args.about: The method's arguments, the for-who first.

move.about: Moves this box to a spot (loc, or x, y, z); await true waits until it gets there.

priority.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

movement.about: Movement for these boxes: jump, crouch, stand, walk or run, stop following, block or unblock moving, a jump route, walk on the nav mesh to a spot, face a heading or an actor.

aboveY.about: Read by the engine (one shipped file).

completed.about: jumpRoute: a spot that means the route is done (inferred).

jumpWithin.about: jumpRoute: how close to the jump spot before jumping.

runMode.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

seconds.about: faceLock: how long to hold the facing.

sendTo.about: Also send it to these boxes.

settleMs.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

x.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

y.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

z.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

valuesAbout.stopFollow: stop following and halt the move in progress (no block: a camp spot pulls again next pulse)
valuesAbout.holdUp: read by the engine; no shipped use
valuesAbout.block: hold still under a reason (counted; undo with unblock)
valuesAbout.jumpRoute: run from start, jump at jump, land at end (or legs)
valuesAbout.navTo: walk to loc on the nav mesh
valuesAbout.navInRange: walk within range of actor (no shipped use)
valuesAbout.setCombatAutoFace: the game's combat auto-face on or off (value)
valuesAbout.faceLock: keep facing actor (away: the back) for seconds

op.about: What to do: stopFollow, holdUp, block, unblock, clearBlocks, jump, crouch, stand, setRunMode, jumpRoute, stopJumpRoute, navTo, navInRange, setCombatAutoFace, faceLock, faceUnlock, faceHeading.

noDefensive.about: Holds back (value true) or allows (value false) defensive abilities on these boxes, under a reason.

reason.about: The hold's name; a release must use the same one.

noOffensive.about: Holds back (value true) or allows (value false) offensive abilities on these boxes, under a reason; a release under another reason releases nothing. The fight's end releases it.

reason.about: The hold's name; a release must use the same one.

ogreBotUIOption.about: Sets an OgreBot option (a checkbox id such as checkbox_settings_castwhilemoving) to true or false, or puts it back (op restore). Options a file writes are put back when the fight or the zone run ends, however it ends.

sendTo.about: Also send it to these boxes.

value.about: true or false (TRUE and FALSE are seen too).

valuesAbout.restore: put it back as it was

onScreenTimer.about: Shows a countdown or a line on screen in slot 1 to 10 (time in seconds, message, minUpdate), or clears a slot (op clear).

message.about: The text; the time left follows it.

minUpdate.about: How often the display updates, in seconds (inferred).

slot.about: The slot 1 to 10, or a list of slots to clear.

time.about: Seconds to count down; 0 shows the message alone.

pet.about: Pet control on these boxes: attack sends the pet in, off calls it back, getLost dismisses it.

stayOff.about: off: also tick Do not send pet to attack (the fight's end puts the option back).

op.about: What to do: attack, off, assist, getLost.

raw.about: Runs one InnerSpace console line on this box (in a zone file: on the IC character only). For what no action covers; oc lines reach other boxes.

command.about: The line, such as oc !ci -SetUpFor igw:{{me}} "<named>". A bare ${...} is not allowed in a zone file: write LavishScript["${...}"].

replyDialog.about: op choose: picks the dialog reply that contains text (contains, not equals). The engine knows it; no shipped file uses it.

text.about: Text that only one reply has.

report.about: A roll call for a mechanic: start opens one, in reports who into the list (each box builds the same list), complete marks someone done. rosterOrder then numbers it.

broadcast.about: Also send the report to the other boxes (as event).

singleTargetCuresOnly.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

timeout.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

window.about: The report-in window in ms. It starts at the first report; a report after it closes starts a new roll call and wipes the list.

op.about: What to do: in, complete, start.

repositionOnCondition.about: enter moves the box to its own spot of a list (index or indexVar picks which one); exit brings it back.

index.about: Which spot (1 = the first), or a rank value.

indexVar.about: The encounter variable that holds the index.

mode.about: absolute (the spots are places) or relativeBy (offsets from the camp spot).

spots.about: A list of [x, y, z], or a spotTables name.

rosterOrder.about: Numbers a roll call (op alpha: by name) and keeps my place in var.

var.about: The encounter variable that gets my place.

who.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

runscript.about: Runs a LavishScript script (script, args); in a zone file on the IC character only. The engine knows it; no shipped file uses it.

script.about: Calls a function (op call) or a method (op method) of a running script. The engine knows it; no shipped file uses it.

setVar.about: Keeps a value under a name: scope encounter (this fight, on this box) or global (kept outside the fight). op add adds to it, unset forgets it, unsetPrefix forgets every name starting with name. Read it as {{encounter.<name>}} or test it with varEquals.

value.about: Text, a number, or a computed value such as { "calc": {...} } or { "textAfter": {...} }.

valuesAbout.unsetPrefix: forget every name starting with name

op.about: What to do: set, add, unset, unsetPrefix.

stopEvaluating.about: In an onPulse rule: skip the rules after this one for this pulse (an if / else-if chain, in file order).

template.about: Runs a ready-made mechanic (use): tankSwap, removeTankSwap, radialSpread, dispel, getAwayToCure, returnFromCure, walkToActor, walkToActorAndInteract, castMonitor.

op.about: tankSwap: prepare, swapOut, swapIn or remove; dispel: ability.

completeEvent.about: returnFromCure: the event sent when done.

reportIn.about: getAwayToCure: report into the roll call (true when left out; inferred).

detType.about: The detriment kind, such as arcane.

spots.about: getAwayToCure: the spots; radialSpread: how many.

indexVar.about: The encounter variable that holds my index.

as.about: walkToActorAndInteract: the name it is bound to.

timeout.about: getAwayToCure: the longest wait for the cure (ms).

threatIgnoreList.about: Puts this box on (add) or takes it off (remove) the threat-ignore list of the boxes in sendTo; clear empties the list. Used in tank swaps (inferred).

name.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

op.about: What to do: add, remove, clear.

timer.about: Two forms. name + set: start a countdown of set ms (0 resets it), read with timerExpired and timerLeft. event + after: send a custom event to this box after a delay; a later timer with the same key replaces it.

after.about: The delay, such as "8s" (a bare number is seconds).

every.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

global.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

interval.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

key.about: A later timer with the same key replaces this one.

payload.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

persistent.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

repeats.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

tts.about: Says message out loud (text to speech) on these boxes.

useItem.about: Uses an item: op use (item, on target), op cure (drink a cure potion of type), op drinkAlcohol (item).

onlyIfDet.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

partial.about: A part of the name is enough (inferred).

priority.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

slot.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

target.about: Who or what to use it on.

type.about: op cure: trauma, noxious, arcane or elemental.

op.about: What to do: use, cure, drinkAlcohol.

waypoint.about: Points the game's waypoint (the on-screen trail) at a spot on these boxes; it moves nobody (inferred from the shipped notes: every session gets a waypoint to it).

zoneDoorWindow.about: op choose: picks a row (destination) in an open zone door window, on one box. The engine knows it; no shipped file uses it.

destination.about: The row: its text or its number.

resolve.about: Finds one actor and binds it to a name, read as {{seq.<as>.id}}, .name, .x ... A step that reads a binding nothing filled fails, so put a stop first when the find can come back empty.

find.about: { "query" } or { "name" }, with nth { "nearestTo": [x, y, z], "rank", "within" } to pick one; without nth the lowest id wins.

as.about: The name it is bound to.

onMissing.about: Nothing found: skip, proceed or fail.

rotate.about: Read by the engine (over, as, id); no shipped file uses it (inferred: takes turns over a list).

over.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

as.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

id.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

stop.about: Ends the list it is in: the rest of its steps are skipped (with when, a guard). In a rule it ends that run only.

id.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

verdict.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

runOnExitAfterwards.about: Read by the engine; no shipped file uses it.

triggerKindsAbout.text: a line in the text feed: emotes, combat and system lines ({{chat.message}}, {{chat.tokenN}}, {{chat.nameN}})
triggerKindsAbout.chat: a line said in a chat channel (match.chatType is the channel number; {{chat.speaker}} says who)
triggerKindsAbout.spawnDelayed: an actor appeared a moment ago (about 1 s later, once its look can be read)
triggerKindsAbout.detAdded: a detriment lands on this box (each box sees only its own)
triggerKindsAbout.detRemoved: a detriment comes off this box
triggerKindsAbout.detUpdated: a detriment on this box changes (match.field, compare, value: for example currentincrements > 10)
triggerKindsAbout.custom: any other name is a custom event sent by broadcast, fireEvent or timer; its values are {{event.arg1}} ...

waitWordsAbout.atCampSpot: until I stand on my camp spot
waitWordsAbout.moveFinished: until my last move (move, movement navTo ...) is done

stepShapesAbout.do: An action: "do" names it and the step carries its keys.
stepShapesAbout.wait: A wait: "ms", "atCampSpot", "moveFinished" (fight files) or a condition, with limitMs and onTimeout.
stepShapesAbout.repeat: A loop: { "times": n } or { "until": [...], "max": n }, with its own steps.
stepShapesAbout.forEach: A loop over actors (find), spots or saved values (vars), with its own steps.
stepShapesAbout.use: Fight files: run a routine of this file, { "use": "<name>", "with": { ... } }.

templatesAbout.castMonitor: read by the engine; no shipped file uses it
templatesAbout.dispel: a mage dispel of main / back off mob (op ability)
templatesAbout.getAwayToCure: go to my own spot of spots (by the roll call list) to be cured away from the group
templatesAbout.radialSpread: spread out round the camp spot, spots places distance apart (indexVar)
templatesAbout.removeTankSwap: end the tank swap: fighters back to normal
templatesAbout.returnFromCure: come back after the cure and send completeEvent
templatesAbout.tankSwap: tank swaps: prepare, swapOut, swapIn, remove (reason)
templatesAbout.walkToActor: read by the engine; no shipped file uses it
templatesAbout.walkToActorAndInteract: walk to an actor (find, as) and use it (interact)

valueKindsAbout.rank: my place among a class or all: { "among", "scope": "group" | "raid", "playersOnly" }
valueKindsAbout.spotIndex: the number of the spot nearest to someone: { "spots", "nearestTo" }
valueKindsAbout.textToken: the nth word of a text: { "text", "index", "sep" }
valueKindsAbout.actorField: a property of an actor: { "id", "field" } (targetName, TintFlags ...)
valueKindsAbout.count: a count, as the count condition counts: { "of", ... }
valueKindsAbout.cursedMember: a cursed member, in an order of archetypes: { "order", "groupOnly", "uncurable" }
valueKindsAbout.preferredMember: the nth preferred member of an archetype: { "pool", "rank" }
valueKindsAbout.itemCount: how many of an item I hold: { "item" }
valueKindsAbout.detEffectString: a line of a detriment's effect text: { "main", "back", "line" }
valueKindsAbout.detIndex: which detriment of a detTables list is on me: { "dets", "prefer" }
valueKindsAbout.groupCooldownSpread: how far apart the group used an ability: { "ability", "withinMs" }
valueKindsAbout.groupMember: a group member with a property: { "race" }

varScopesAbout.encounter: this fight, on this box: read as {{encounter.<name>}}
varScopesAbout.global: kept outside the fight (users and other files set them too): {{global.<name>}}
varScopesAbout.group: conditions and computed values: count or rank over my group
varScopesAbout.raid: conditions and computed values: count or rank over my raid

abilityReady.about: An ability of mine is ready (name, ability or abilityId; recastOnly: only its recast is checked).

actorCoord.about: A coordinate (axis x, y or z) of me (of: me) or an actor compares with value.

actorIs.about: The actor id (a name or an id) is so: dead, feignDeath, aura, overlay, tooltip, tintFlags, guild, type, targetName, currentAnimation, name.

actorNear.about: An actor matching find is within m of me, my camp spot (of), a spot (ofLoc) or an actor (ofActor); compare and value count them.

actorPresent.about: An actor (name or id) is up; compare and count say how many.

actorTarget.about: The actor id is targeting someone in my group (inMyGroup) or of an archetype.

afflicted.about: Someone (name, or who: group or raid) carries a detriment of a kind (arcane, elemental, noxious, trauma); uncurable for ones that cannot be cured.

assistInControl.about: OgreBot's assist is in control of my target (inferred).

atCampSpot.about: I stand on my camp spot.

campSpotRelative.about: My relative camp spot is set (inferred).

chatMatch.about: The firing line matches (needle, mode, chatType, field). No shipped file uses it.

collision.about: Something blocks the line between the from and to spots.

count.about: A count compares with value: actors matching find (of actors), saved values with a prefix (of vars), cursed members (of cursed), or roster members of a class (of roster, by, is, scope).

csp.about: Read by the engine (value); no shipped file uses it.

curePotionReady.about: My cure potion of type is ready.

detTimeLeft.about: The detriment (main / back or det) on me, or on actor, has more or less than value seconds left.

distance.about: The distance between to and from (me when left out; a spot, campSpot or an actor) compares with value, or with another distance (valueOf); 2d ignores height.

flag.about: Read by the engine (id, value); no shipped file uses it.

groupDistance.about: The farthest group member (pick farthest) is within value of me (inferred).

hasAbility.about: I have this ability at all (ability or abilityId).

hasDet.about: A detriment (main and back, or det) is on me, or on actor; compare and value test its increments; maxEffects caps how many effects are read.

heroicOpportunity.about: The heroic opportunity is in a state (open, solo, wheel, myStart, primed, starter), for me or an archetype; timeLeft compares the time left.

itemReady.about: My item is ready to use (partial: a part of its name).

jumpRoute.about: My jump route is running or failed.

lootWindow.about: A loot window of type (such as Leader Only) shows item.

maintained.about: I maintain this ability (it is up).

mobHealthPct.about: The named's health % compares with value.

ms.about: Never true: a wait step's plain pause, over after its limitMs (Ogre's ic.schema.json).

moveFinished.about: My last move is done (the wait word moveFinished).

myStat.about: One of my values compares with value: health, IsFD, pet, cursed, noxious, arcane, trauma, elemental ...

namedCasting.about: The named is casting (abilityId: this ability) (inferred).

nearSpot.about: I (of: me), my camp spot (campSpot) or its base (campSpotAnchor) is within m of a spot of spots (index picks one).

option.about: An OgreBot option (id) is true or false.

questStep.about: Read by the engine (quest, step, done); no shipped file uses it.

raidSlot.about: I am in this raid slot (slot 1 = the raid's first) (inferred).

replyDialog.about: A dialog reply containing text shows. No shipped file uses it.

rewardWindow.about: The reward window is open. No shipped file uses it.

roster.about: A roll call (list) is in a state: windowOver, settled, timedOut or done.

ruleState.about: An onPulse rule (id) is in a state (is: inactive).

textEquals.about: text equals value. Two empty texts do not count as equal (a shipped note), so keep "0" rather than "".

threatToMe.about: My threat on the named compares with value (%).

timerExpired.about: The countdown name has run out.

timerLeft.about: The milliseconds left on the countdown name compare with value.

untoldTier.about: This run's Untold tier compares with value.

varCompare.about: A saved value (scope, name) compares with value as a number.

varEquals.about: A saved value (scope, name) equals value ("" for not set).

zone.about: The zone's name is (is) or contains (contains, also a list) the text.

zoneDoorWindow.about: A zone door window with destination is open. No shipped file uses it.

forwho.about: Beside other conditions in one object: true on the boxes the for-who names.

not.about: A list of conditions; true when none of them is.

or.about: A list of conditions; true when any of them is.

and.about: A list of conditions; true when all of them are.

tokens.lavishScript: LavishScript is written LavishScript["${...}"]. A bare ${...} makes a zone file not valid.

rootsAbout.chat: in a text or chat rule: {{chat.message}}, {{chat.speaker}}, {{chat.tokenN}} (the nth word), {{chat.nameN}} (the nth word, cleaned)
rootsAbout.actor: in a spawn or despawn rule: {{actor.id}}, {{actor.name}}
rootsAbout.det: in a detriment rule: the detriment
rootsAbout.encounter: {{encounter.<name>}}: a value setVar kept for this fight (and groupQuery answers)
rootsAbout.global: {{global.<name>}}: a value kept outside the fight
rootsAbout.seq: {{seq.<as>.id}}, .name, .x, .y, .z, .loc, .distance: the current one of a forEach, or what resolve bound
rootsAbout.ability: {{ability}}: the ability, in a castAbility announce

forWho.about: Who runs a step (forwho) or who a command is sent to (sendTo, responders). | means or, + means and, a leading - means not; + binds tighter than |. Words: all, me, a character name, archetypes (fighter, priest, mage, scout, healer), melee, caster, classes (warrior, crusader, brawler, cleric, druid, shaman, shaper, sorcerer, enchanter, summoner, rogue, bard, predator, animalist) and subclasses, not<word> (notfighter), groupleader, igw:<name> (in group with), irw:<name> (in raid with), igwbn:<name> / irwbn:<name> (the same but not that one), groups:<digits> and g1 to g4 (raid groups), @aliases (@Tank, @Healer1, @DPS1, @Scout1 ...), *Team:<name> (a ForWho group), ToonFlagged:<n>.
